feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values and arithmetic for life gained, damage, excess damage, counters placed, discarded counts, trigger-object toughness and power, mana-spent and per-turn tallies, poison counters, distinct names, greater-of counts, and per-creature self-damage amounts.

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector predicates for keywords in statics, tapped and power-comparison tests (strictly less than, against a chosen target or hand size), shared creature types, combined power and toughness, cards put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn, spell-or-creature and legendary-spell target kinds, and attacker-damaged-you selectors.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add effects for the Ring tempting you, earthbend, airbend, die rolls, coin-flip replacement, face-down turns and piles, rad counters, and the commit-a-crime trigger.

feature: Conditional rule statics and permissions
description: Add rule statics for life-total locks, can't-attack, forced blocks, nonbasic untap limits, spell-name prohibitions, revealed hands, flash grants, mana-spend zone restrictions, hand-zone ability grants, and condition fields on play-from-zone statics.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for expend, damage to any player, cards leaving the graveyard, playing a land, enchanted-player creature entering, enchanted-creature damage, per-type casts, player-only attacks, spell-only targeting, and blocker-and-blocked pairs.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope and chooser fields so sacrifice, token creation and choice effects can address each player, each opponent, a per-opponent condition, the controller of a dying or damaging creature, or an opponent making the choice.

feature: Alternative-cost keyword mechanics
description: Model foretell, miracle, evoke, buyback, suspend, encore and overload as alternative casts or costs with exile, time-counter, return-to-hand and sacrifice riders.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add keywords the schema lacks or cannot grant: skulk, landwalk, decayed, myriad, mobilize with sacrifice, reconfigure, protection from creature subtypes, and granted cascade.

feature: Library and graveyard repositioning
description: Add shuffle-into-owner's-library for targets, mill-half, positional placement such as third from the top, combined library-and-graveyard searches, partial library exile, and untargeted random returns.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add entry options for returned, searched and put-onto-battlefield cards (tapped, attacking, attached, from another player's hand or a graveyard).

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add conditions for what happened this turn (life gained, counters put on this creature, permanents leaving the battlefield, instants or sorceries cast, defendant's land count) and opponent-by-opponent graveyard checks.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add any-number, announced-count, optional-zero and total-power target slots, plus counter moves and distribution of any or an exact number of counters.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add free or alternative casting of cards from graveyards, exile and opponents' libraries, with exile-instead, random choice, copy, once-per-turn and ordering riders.

feature: Reference to the card moved by the previous effect
description: Let follow-up effects, reflexive triggers and delayed returns refer to the card or permanent the previous effect moved, searched, exiled or created, including chaining on success and returning under your control.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost components (return a permanent to hand, the untap symbol, discard filtered by type, reveal-or-pay choices, return-a-land alternatives to an unless cost) and rule statics that set minimum spell costs.

feature: Temporary or permanent characteristic-setting effects
description: Add effects that set base power and toughness for a group, make permanent creatures, and add creature subtypes, types and colors to returned or off-battlefield cards.

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Let selectors, effects and repeats take the announced X or a computed count (mana value X, proliferate X times) instead of a fixed number.

feature: Damage prevention and replacement variants
description: Add damage redirection, prevention scoped to a group, damage-to-counter conversion, and enter-the-battlefield and sacrifice-instead replacements.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, exile-until and mill-then-pick loops, per-type picks and opponent-driven splits that route found and leftover cards to different places.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Let token and spell copies carry riders: exile at end step, copy per creature with retargeting, removal of the legendary supertype, extra counters conditional on control, and token creation riders such as self-exile.

feature: Counterspell variants
description: Let counter effects and follow-ups act on the controller of the countered spell, and gain control of or retarget a spell.

feature: Durations until end of your next turn
description: Allow exile-and-play, become-creature and delayed-return effects to last until your next turn or upkeep instead of only this turn or the next end step.

feature: Sacrificed cost object's power/mana value
description: Add Values and conditions that read the power, type or identity of an object sacrificed or discarded as a cost.

feature: one-off
description: Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.
